string.text: Improved gas-port
Modified gas-port enables smoother operation with decreased recoil with higher muzzle velocity.
Barrel adjustment
Decreases bullet spread, which improves accuracy.
Faster twist rate
Barrel with a faster twist rate increases muzzle velocity, thus improves the flatness of the trajectory and faster hits the target. Useful for long range fire.
Protective coating
Application of a protective coating to the internal parts significantly reduces wear.
Tactical flashlight
Long-range narrow beam flashlight is essential for night raids, as well as to search and clear poorly-lit rooms. Does not interfere with the laser sight and can be installed along with it.
Rail mount
Replacement gas-tube cover with multiple Picatinny rails allows to attach various tactical devices (laser sight, tactical flashlight, and additional types of sights).
Anatomical pistol grip
Provides better grip for the right hand.
More durable parts
Improves durability of the gun by replacing weapon parts with their strengthened counterparts.
Laser sight

Provides a visual point of reference, visually marks the expected point of impact, facilitates and speeds up aiming, and has a demoralizing effect on the enemy. Does not interfere with the tactical flashlight and can be installed along with it.
Improved feeding mechanism
Reduces the number of malfunctions related to feeding issues.
Hammer release delay device
Makes firing more stable by decreasing the rate of fire, helps save ammunition. Decreases barrel heat up, thus increases weapon's lifespan.
Lightweight parts
Reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts without any significant loss in other performance characteristics.
Recoil pad
Anatomical rubberized recoil pad reduced felt recoil.
Lightweight stock
Reduces weight by replacing the standard stock with a maintenance counterpart.
Improved ejector
Improved ejector decreases the probability of malfunctions related to ejecting an empty case from the firearm.
Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Tactical foregrip
Improves handling and facilitates recoil control.
Trigger tuning
Modification of the trigger mechanism increases rate of fire, at the cost of durability.
Trigger calibration
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improve accuracy, while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Compensator
Integrated compensator significantly reduces the felt recoil impulse and makes the shooting more comfortable.
Balanced bolt carrier
Balanced bolt carrier group reduces muzzle climb and probability of malfunctions.
Chamber adjustment
Improves obturation and accuracy by removing play in the chamber.
45 round magazine (black)
Extended magazine allows to decrease the number of reloads in combat, increasing chances of survival.
45 round magazine (black)
Extended magazine allows to decrease the number of reloads in combat, increasing chances of survival.
60 round magazine
High capacity magazine allows to send even more enemies to a better place with a single continuous burst.
